description: This file defines the custom exception class `InteropTransferMissingException` used in the interoperation module of the project, extending a platform resource not found exception to handle specific missing transfer scenarios.

classes.name: InteropTransferMissingException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific interoperation transfer with given transfer code and account ID is missing.

methods.name: InteropTransferMissingException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific error message based on transfer code and account ID.
